faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Revenue and Forest Department, Government of Maharashtra (Tehsildar and Executive Magistrate Office, Khed, Ratnagiri) for filling up vacant positions locally.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Revenue Servant (Kotwal), offering temporary employment opportunities under the revenue administration of Khed taluka, Ratnagiri district.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies available for the Revenue Servant (Kotwal) position across various designated villages and saz locations in Khed taluka.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed at least the 4th standard and possess good working knowledge of the Marathi language to be eligible for the post.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: Applicants must be between 18 and 40 years of age as of 02-10-2026. Age relaxations apply according to government rules and categories.

faq.question: Q6. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the filled offline application form along with required documents and fee receipt is 17-10-2026.

faq.question: Q7. How should the application form be submitted?
faq.answer: Applications must be obtained from the Tehsildar Khed office and submitted in person by hand along with documents and fee receipt. Postal submissions are not accepted.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection procedure for this job?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises a written examination consisting of 50 objective multiple-choice questions carrying 100 marks, followed by document verification.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: Yes, the application fee is Rs. 300 for Backward Class candidates and Rs. 500 for General and Other category candidates, payable in cash.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the job location for selected candidates?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will be posted in Khed Taluka, specifically within designated villages and saz areas such as Kasbanatu, Dhamani, Musad, Bhoste, and Bijghar.
